works.title: Dating in the Fifties
works.description: A nonfiction book project extracting wisdom from dozens of dating conversations and experiences. The user is developing a structured three-pass methodology (cluster & counterbalance theses, outline outcome patterns, then manuscript with chapter template) to transform scattered dating insights into a coherent work exploring dating dynamics, MBTI personality types, masculine/feminine polarity, and relationship strategies.
works.quote: I probably have two or three dozen dating threads like this, and some of them went on so long that ChatGPT finally notified me that I couldn't add anymore to that thread.

works.title: Best Practices Manual for AI Prompt Optimization
works.description: An instructional guide establishing best practices for converting prompts into formats that AI can understand efficiently with minimal ambiguity, focusing on definition clarity and grammatical/syntactic structure to reduce hallucination. The user is commissioning research synthesis across linguistics, cognitive science, and AI alignment literature to ground the manual empirically.
works.quote: in order to establish a best practices instruction manual for converting any prompt into a format and structure that AI can use efficiently with minimal ambiguity to reduce hallucination
